name: otty
title: Otty
description: Control the Otty terminal from Raycast.
author: Ethan_Cao

commands.name: search-tabs
commands.title: Search Otty Tabs
commands.description: Browse Otty windows, tabs, and panes, and switch to one.

commands.name: agents-menu-bar
commands.title: Otty Agents
commands.subtitle: Otty
commands.description: Show coding agents that need input in the menu bar, and jump to them.

commands.name: jump-to-directory
commands.title: Jump to Directory
commands.description: Open one of Otty's most-visited folders, or a git repository, in a new tab.

preferences.name: repositoriesDirectory
preferences.title: Repositories Folder
preferences.description: Folder to scan for git repositories.

preferences.name: repositoriesScanDepth
preferences.title: Scan Depth
preferences.description: How many folder levels to search below it.

commands.name: open-recipe
commands.title: Open Otty Recipe
commands.description: Open an exported Otty recipe to rebuild its tabs and panes.

preferences.name: recipesDirectory
preferences.title: Recipes Folder
preferences.description: Folder that holds your exported .ottyrecipe files.

commands.name: otty-settings
commands.title: Otty Settings
commands.description: Browse Otty's settings, toggle them, and edit values.

commands.name: change-theme
commands.title: Change Otty Theme
commands.description: Pick Otty's light-mode and dark-mode themes from a grid of previews.

commands.name: open-in-otty
commands.title: Open in Otty
commands.description: Open the selected Finder items, or the front Finder window, in Otty.

commands.name: new-tab
commands.title: New Tab
commands.description: Open a new Otty tab, falling back to a new window if needed.

commands.name: run-command
commands.title: Run Command
commands.description: Run a shell command in Otty.

commands.name: ssh
commands.title: SSH

preferences.name: ottyCliPath
preferences.title: Otty CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the Otty control CLI.
